question: A company produces bulbs and the profit function is given by $P(x) = -x^2 + 28x - 120$ (where $x$ is the number of bulbs in thousands). (i) Find the number of bulbs for which profit is maximum. (ii) Find the maximum profit. (iii) Find the intervals where profit is increasing. [4 marks]

A ball is thrown upward and its height $h$ in meters at time $t$ seconds is $h(t) = 20t - 5t^2$. (i) Find the maximum height reached by the ball. (ii) Find the velocity of the ball at $t = 1$ second. [4 marks]

A manufacturer can sell $x$ items at a price of $p = 5 - x/100$ each. The cost price of $x$ items is $C(x) = x/5 + 500$. (i) Find the revenue function $R(x)$. (ii) Find the number of items for maximum profit. [4 marks]
solutionSteps: i) Revenue $R(x) = p \cdot x = x(5 - x/100) = 5x - x^2/100$.

question: A farmer wants to fence a rectangular field with 400m of fencing. One side is a river. (i) Write area $A$ as a function of $x$. (ii) Find dimensions for maximum area. [4 marks]
A cuboidal box with a square base and open top is to be made of 48 sq. units of cardboard. (i) Express height $h$ in terms of base side $x$. (ii) Find dimensions for maximum volume. [4 marks]
solutionSteps: i) Surface Area $S = x^2 + 4xh = 48 \Rightarrow 4xh = 48 - x^2 \Rightarrow h = \frac{48-x^2}{4x}$.
